story_type: sailboat aground in breaking surf, swimmer drops in, three young men basket-hoisted
hook: Their sailboat ran aground in the surf. A swimmer dropped in.
narration: The rescue swimmer dropped straight into the breaking surf.
Three young men had run their sailboat aground near Fripp Island, South Carolina, and the waves kept slamming it.
All three were wearing life jackets, which hold your head up even when a wave knocks you flat.
One by one, the swimmer got them into the rescue basket.
[short pause] And one by one, the basket rose up out of the waves.
outcome: The Coast Guard crew hoisted all three young men up into the helicopter.
title: Sailboat aground in the surf, 3 aboard
description:
On April 22, 2015, a Coast Guard Air Station Savannah aircrew hoisted three young men after their sailboat ran aground and was buffeted by the sea near Fripp Island, South Carolina. All three were wearing life jackets.
